games.name: Hitman: Absolution™
games.short_description: The original assassin is back! Betrayed by the Agency and hunted by the police, Agent 47 finds himself pursuing redemption in a corrupt and twisted world.
games.short_description_en: The original assassin is back! Betrayed by the Agency and hunted by the police, Agent 47 finds himself pursuing redemption in a corrupt and twisted world.

games.name: ASYLUM
games.short_description: 一場格局宏大的超自然恐怖冒險，也是邪典神作《驚恐鬼屋》的精神續作。故事發生在一間龐大、荒敗的精神病院，靈感源自 H·P·洛夫克拉夫特的作品、漢默影業，以及 80 年代風格扭曲的歐洲恐怖電影。
games.short_description_en: An epic supernatural horror adventure and the spiritual successor to cult classic Scratches set in a massive, decaying mental institute. Inspired by H. P. Lovecraft, Hammer Films and twisted Euro Horror from the 80s.

games.name: Frostpunk
games.short_description: 《冰汽時代》是首款以社會生存為題材的遊戲。作為世上最後一座城市的管理者，你必須對人民及裡面的基礎設施進行管理。你將會採取哪種決定來確保你的社會生存下去？當你被推到極限時，會採取什麼策略？在此過程中，你將扮演什麼角色？
games.short_description_en: Frostpunk is the first society survival game. As the ruler of the last city on Earth, it is your duty to manage both its citizens and infrastructure. What decisions will you make to ensure your society's survival? What will you do when pushed to breaking point? Who will you become in the process?

games.name: A Bird Story
games.short_description: An experimental short from the creator of To the Moon & Finding Paradise: A simple & surreal 1-hour interactive animation about a boy and an injured bird, told without dialogues. If you're looking for To the Moon-like experience, I'd suggest playing Finding Paradise first.
games.short_description_en: An experimental short from the creator of To the Moon & Finding Paradise: A simple & surreal 1-hour interactive animation about a boy and an injured bird, told without dialogues. If you're looking for To the Moon-like experience, I'd suggest playing Finding Paradise first.

games.name: Mafia III: Definitive Edition
games.short_description: 1968年新波爾多 在參加了多年越戰之後，林肯·克雷明白了這個真理：家人並不是伴你而生的人，而是你願意為之赴死的人。當他的代理家族，黑色暴徒，被義大利黑手黨背叛並滅門之後，林肯在一片瘡痍之上創建了一個新的家族，並用鐵血的手段向那些與滅門事件有關的黑手黨成員進行報復和復仇。
games.short_description_en: After Lincoln Clay's surrogate family, the black mob, is betrayed and killed by the Italian Mafia, Lincoln builds a new family and blazes a path of revenge through the Mafioso responsible.

games.name: Quern - Undying Thoughts
games.short_description: 探索 Quern 過往的真相、解開其當代的謎題併成為改變未來的探索家。 Quern 將可反覆用使用的謎題機制融入傳統謎題遊戲之中，讓玩家們能夠融匯整款遊戲中的謎題而非進行一道道毫無關聯的挑戰。
games.short_description_en: Discover the truth about Quern’s past, unfold the mysteries of its present, and be the explorer who shapes its future. Quern introduces reusable puzzle mechanics to the classic genre, making the player think about the game as a whole, and not just as a series of individual challenges.

games.name: Ancestors: The Humankind Odyssey
games.short_description: 跟著《先祖：人類奧德賽》回到一千萬年前，在人類起源之際的非洲大陸率領家族，盡情探索環境、擴張領土並演化，成功存活下來。
games.short_description_en: Survive your evolution in Neogene Africa starting 10 million years ago. Ancestors: The Humankind Odyssey is a third-person open world survival game where you Explore, Expand, and Evolve to advance your clan to the next generation in the exciting new adventure from Panache Digital Games.

games.name: Resident Evil 2
games.short_description: 一切都凌駕於玩家的想像之上。 一場生化災難於1998年9月襲擊了浣熊市，從殘害倖存者的喪屍地獄中生還吧。 無盡的刺激、引人入勝的故事和無法想像的恐怖正在等候你。 見證系列首屈一指的傑作──《Resident Evil 2》的重生吧。 別被這場慘劇吞噬。
games.short_description_en: A deadly virus engulfs the residents of Raccoon City in September of 1998, plunging the city into chaos as flesh eating zombies roam the streets for survivors. An unparalleled adrenaline rush, gripping storyline, and unimaginable horrors await you. Witness the return of Resident Evil 2.

games.name: Resident Evil 3
games.short_description: 不管逃到哪裡也會被追至絕路。 拉昆市發生突如其來的生物災害，更為巨大的威脅被投入至這個逐漸崩潰的城鎮中…… 多重的危機、九死一生的驚險動作和重新建構的逃生劇，一一超乎你的預想。 你能逃離這片絕望嗎？ 同時收錄《Resident Evil Resistance》。
games.short_description_en: Jill Valentine is one of the last remaining people in Raccoon City to witness the atrocities Umbrella performed. To stop her, Umbrella unleashes their ultimate secret weapon: Nemesis! Also includes Resident Evil Resistance, a new 1 vs 4 online multiplayer game set in the Resident Evil universe.

games.name: EARTH DEFENSE FORCE 5
games.short_description: 人類啊，對抗命運吧！ 本款遊戲是描寫人類在西元2022年，面對突如其來侵襲地球的外星生命體，賭上「全地球防衛機構」EDF的性命與之戰鬥的動作射擊遊戲。 玩家將化身EDF的士兵，一一殲滅來勢洶洶無以計數的巨大敵人，守護地球的和平。
games.short_description_en: Stand and fight for humanity. This arcade shooter takes place in the year 2022, as the Earth Defense Force fends off an all-out attack by unknown life forms. Become an EDF soldier, battle against endless hordes of immense enemies, and restore peace to the earth.

games.name: Marvel's Guardians of the Galaxy
games.short_description: 《漫威星際異攻隊》將帶你踏上盪氣迴腸、驚險萬分的星際之旅，透過令人耳目一新的視角任你馳騁星際、縱橫宇宙。玩家將在這部動作冒險遊戲扮演星爵，率領一言不合就爆走的星際異攻隊，闖過一場又一場昏天暗地的大混戰。你沒問題的。應該啦。
games.short_description_en: Fire up a wild ride across the cosmos with a fresh take on Marvel’s Guardians of the Galaxy. In this action-adventure game, you are Star-Lord leading the unpredictable Guardians from one explosion of chaos to the next. You got this. Probably.

games.name: Kingdom of Night
games.short_description: 《闇夜王國》是一款以80年代為主題的等角視角動作RPG。追捕噩夢般的惡魔，拯救亞利桑那州邁阿密鎮。遊戲擁有廣闊且相連的地圖與開放式任務，讓你在自由探索中逐步揭開主線故事的真相。體驗成長故事、克蘇魯式恐怖與真愛的獨特融合。
games.short_description_en: Hunt down nightmarish demons and save the town of Miami, AZ in this 80s-themed, isometric action-RPG. With an expansive, interconnected map and open-ended quests, explore freely while unraveling the main story. Kingdom of Night is a unique blend of coming-of-age drama, cosmic horror, and true love.

games.name: The Slormancer
games.short_description: 在這款怪誕的史詩級ARPG遊戲中，你將與來自過去的邪惡的魂巫及其眾多僕從作戰！在這裡，你可以體驗到眩目的戰利品、無數的收藏品、海量的遊戲內容，瘋狂的遊戲玩法和經典的像素藝術！
games.short_description_en: Fight hordes of enemies led by The Slormancer, an evil warlock from the past, in an absurd yet epic Action RPG! Experience fast-paced gameplay, loads of shiny loot, tons of collectibles, countless hours of content, and carefully crafted pixel art.

games.name: Titan Quest II
games.short_description: 復仇女神——涅墨西斯失控了。她正在腐蝕「命運之線」，懲罰所有反對她的人。《Titan Quest II》是一款受取材自希臘神話打造而成的動作類角色扮演遊戲，在這款遊戲中，你將拿起武器與諸神並肩作戰，改變命運。
games.short_description_en: Nemesis, Goddess of Retribution, is out of control. She is corrupting the Threads of Fate and punishing all those who oppose her. Take up your weapon, fight alongside gods, and change fate itself in Titan Quest II, an action RPG inspired by Greek mythology.

games.name: Coral Island
games.short_description: 《Coral Island 珊瑚島》是一款充滿活力又悠閒的多人農場模擬遊戲！你可以按自己的節奏享受迷人的海島生活：與朋友一起耕種、照料動物、建立人際關係、結識各具特色的角色，還能潛入神秘的美人魚王國探險。
games.short_description_en: Coral Island is a vibrant, laid-back farm sim reimagined with multiplayer! Experience enchanting island life at your own pace: farm with friends, nurture animals, build relationships, hang out with a diverse cast of characters, and dive into the magical Merfolk Kingdom.

games.name: House Flipper 2
games.short_description: 用這款輕鬆療癒的裝修模擬器來清除煩惱！購買、修繕、出售，並成為當地的傳奇人物。或者拿起你的電動工具，從頭開始打造任何東西！透過支援2至4名玩家的線上合作模式，你們可以一起玩沙盒模式或故事模式。
games.short_description_en: Clean your worries away with this relaxing renovation simulator! Buy, fix, sell, and become a local legend. Or grab your power tools and build anything from scratch! With the online 2-4 players co-op mode, you can play both in sandbox and story mode together.

games.name: Isles of Sea and Sky
games.short_description: 在海洋風的奇幻開放世界中，進行一場腦洞大開的解謎冒險。與可以改變解謎格局的新朋友結識，並且逐步解鎖新能力，為探索提供更多選擇，在解決新穎推箱謎題的同時揭開一個充滿神話色彩的故事。
games.short_description_en: A fantastic, oceanic, open world puzzle adventure. Solve innovative block puzzles while unearthing a mystifying story, gaining new friends that change the puzzle landscape, and unlocking powers that provide more options for how you choose to progress through the enigmatic Isles of Sea and Sky.

games.name: The Outlast Trials
games.short_description: Red Barrels invites you to experience mind-numbing terror, this time with friends. Whether you go through the trials alone or in teams, if you survive long enough and complete the therapy, Murkoff will happily let you leave… but will you be the same?
games.short_description_en: Red Barrels invites you to experience mind-numbing terror, this time with friends. Whether you go through the trials alone or in teams, if you survive long enough and complete the therapy, Murkoff will happily let you leave… but will you be the same?

games.name: Cult of the Lamb
games.short_description: 在假先知之境裡創立屬於自己的聖教，冒險深入多種神秘地區，建立忠誠追隨者的林地根據地，傳播你的真言，成為一個真正的聖教。
games.short_description_en: Start your own cult in a land of false prophets, venturing out into diverse and mysterious regions to build a loyal community of woodland Followers and spread your Word to become the one true cult.

games.name: The Séance of Blake Manor
games.short_description: 《布雷克莊園的降靈會》是一款超自然偵探推理遊戲，背景設定在1897年的愛爾蘭。你將深入一間隱身鄉間、暗藏秘密與靈異現象的旅館，調查伊芙琳·狄安的失蹤事件。
games.short_description_en: The Séance of Blake Manor is a supernatural detective mystery, set in 1897 Ireland, where you investigate the disappearance of Evelyn Deane in a remote hotel full of secrets and other-worldly occurrences.

games.name: It Takes Two
games.short_description: 在《雙人成行》中踏上人生中最瘋狂的旅程。利用好友通行證*邀請好友免費遊玩。
games.short_description_en: Embark on the craziest journey of your life in It Takes Two. Invite a friend to join for free with Friend’s Pass and work together across a huge variety of gleefully disruptive gameplay challenges. Winner of GAME OF THE YEAR at the Game Awards 2021.

games.name: Disney Epic Mickey: Rebrushed
games.short_description: 歡迎加入《Disney Epic Mickey: Rebrushed》的神奇之旅，展開一場奇幻有趣的冒險！在這款重製的美麗3D橫向捲軸遊戲中，玩家會化身為米奇，運用巧手妙筆打造出專屬於你的冒險，徹底改造荒廢國度。
games.short_description_en: Embark on a magical journey in Disney Epic Mickey: Rebrushed! Shape your adventure with the stroke of a brush and transform Wasteland as Mickey Mouse in this beautifully recreated 3D platformer.

games.name: My Friendly Neighborhood
games.short_description: 《美鄰街》，人人都不願意錯過的週六早間木偶劇，最近好像出了大問題！在這款生存恐怖冒險遊戲中，你將扮演維修員戈登前去調查這讓人不安的離奇局面。抵禦木偶入侵，解開燒腦謎題。
games.short_description_en: Something scary is happening with everyone's favorite Saturday morning puppet show, The Friendly Neighborhood! Play as Gordon, a repairman sent to get to the bottom of this disturbing dilemma. Fend off puppets and solve puzzles in this survival horror adventure.

games.name: Hell is Us
games.display_name: Hell is Us 地獄即我們
games.name_zh_cn: Hell is Us 地狱即我们
games.name_zh_cn_traditional: Hell is Us 地獄即我們
games.short_description: 倘若戰爭便是我們在人間最接近地獄的體驗，那是因為地球上滿是最為可怕的惡魔：人類。在一個飽受內戰蹂躪的孤立國家中，發現自己過去的秘密，並應對一場神秘災難所產生的後續影響。
games.short_description_en: If war is the closest we get to hell on earth, it's because Earth harbours the worst of demons: humankind. In an isolated country ravaged by infighting, discover the secrets of your past and deal with the repercussions of a mysterious calamity.

games.name: A Little to the Left
games.short_description: 《靠左一些些》是令人舒心的拼圖遊戲，供您將居家物品分類、堆疊和整理，成為賞心悅目的整齊狀態，同時還得留意一隻調皮的貓咪，經常喜歡搞破壞。快來玩這個有趣又直觀的解謎遊戲，有 100 多種混亂場景可以打理，給人滿滿的成就感。
games.short_description_en: A Little to the Left is a cozy puzzle game that has you sort, stack, and organize household items into pleasing arrangements while you keep an eye out for a mischievous cat with an inclination for chaos. Check out this playful and intuitive puzzler with 100+ satisfying messes to tidy.

games.name: Moadra
games.short_description: 忍耐……進化……或者滅亡。擁抱未知並穿越一個廣袤的外星世界，其中充斥著怪異的生物、致命的危害以及冷酷的謎團。找尋救贖，並直面埋藏於被遺忘的普羅蒂亞六號行星深處的恐怖罪孽。
games.short_description_en: Endure... Evolve... or die. Embrace the unknown and traverse a vast alien world riddled with bizarre creatures, deadly hazards, and grim mysteries. Seek redemption, and confront the terrifying sin buried in the depths of the forgotten planet Protea VI.

games.name: I Am Your Beast
games.short_description: 在這款由《El Paso, Elsewhere》開發者打造的快速節奏秘密復仇驚悚第一人稱射擊遊戲中，穿梭於風格化的漫畫微型沙盒世界，獵殺軍事工業複合體。
games.short_description_en: Hunt the military-industrial complex across stylish comic book micro-sandboxes in this fast-paced covert revenge thriller FPS from the developers of El Paso, Elsewhere.

games.name: Once Upon A KATAMARI
games.short_description: 滾出好時光 穿梭時空，遊歷世間，滾動塊球，旅途物語。 滾動、捲起、變大，這些都是「塊魂」熟悉的招式。在全新的世界中，滾到滿意為止吧。
games.short_description_en: Once upon a time a katamari rolled through both past and present. In this story across time, the adage endures: Let The Good Times Roll! Now onward through new worlds to roll up thy heart's desires and to restore the stars!

games.name: Pocket Mirror ~ GoldenerTraum
games.short_description: 以《化妝鏡～黃金之夢》視角，深入探索這款廣受好評的哥德式恐怖遊戲，它將帶您踏上一段感人的自我探索之旅。
games.short_description_en: Delve into the enthralling world of Pocket Mirror ~ GoldenerTraum, the acclaimed RPG Maker gothic horror game that'll take you on a moving journey of self-discovery.

games.name: Wild Blue Skies
games.short_description: 《狂野藍天》重新演繹90年代經典的軌道式射擊玩法，加入鮑伊·史特雷與藍色轟炸機小隊的行列，翱翔壯闊天際、迎戰猙爪麾下大軍，堪稱一款動作場面十足，讓新手與老手都欲罷不能的街機射擊遊戲。
games.short_description_en: Wild Blue Skies reimagines the classic on-rails adventures of the '90s. Join Bowie Stray and the Blue Bombers as they soar through breathtaking skies on a mission to save the world, battling Grimclaw's forces in this action-packed arcade shooter built for newcomers and genre veterans alike!

games.name: Darkest Dungeon® II
games.display_name: 暗黑地牢2 Darkest Dungeon II
games.name_zh_cn: 暗黑地牢2 Darkest Dungeon II
games.name_zh_cn_traditional: 暗黑地牢2 Darkest Dungeon II
games.short_description: 《黑暗地牢2》是一場有去無回的Roguelike旅行冒險遊戲。組建隊伍，武裝馬車，穿越腐朽的大地，阻止末日浩劫，然而最大的威脅或許正是你的心魔…
games.short_description_en: Darkest Dungeon II is a roguelike road trip of the damned. Form a party, equip your stagecoach, and set off across the decaying landscape on a last gasp quest to avert the apocalypse. The greatest dangers you face, however, may come from within...

games.name: Resident Evil 4
games.short_description: 生還僅是惡夢的開端。 前所未見的生物災害「拉昆市事件」已過去六年。 成為特務的里昂·S·甘迺迪接獲命令，前往營救被綁架的總統千金。 為此里昂踏進被「瘋狂」支配之地，他的結局會是…… 一場生與死、恐懼與釋懷互相交織的嚴酷營救劇即將揭開帷幕。 透過直觀的操作和最新的畫面，以及再構成的故事重生為全新的生存恐怖體驗。
games.short_description_en: Survival is just the beginning. Six years have passed since the biological disaster in Raccoon City. Leon S. Kennedy, one of the survivors, tracks the president's kidnapped daughter to a secluded European village, where there is something terribly wrong with the locals.

games.name: Dragon's Dogma 2
games.short_description: 能夠響應玩家想像且豐富多彩的動作，以及即使是單人遊玩也能享受「與他人一起冒險的樂趣」的遊戲體驗。 藉助最新的畫面、物理計算及AI人工智能，精心編織而成的王道幻想世界。這個世界充滿著驚喜和現實感。 與旅伴隨從一起，讓我們踏入一場獨一無二的冒險吧。
games.short_description_en: Dragon’s Dogma 2 is a single player, narrative driven action-RPG that challenges the players to choose their own experience – from the appearance of their Arisen, their vocation, their party, how to approach different situations and more - in a truly immersive fantasy world.

games.name: Ravenswatch
games.short_description: 古老童話及傳奇故事的墮落英雄：你正面臨著準備一觸即發的關鍵戰爭，必須對抗噩夢以阻止其入侵及腐化你的世界。由《Curse of the Dead Gods©》創作者所設計的 roguelike 動作遊戲，可單人遊玩或線上合作。
games.short_description_en: Fallen heroes of old folk tales and legends: you are on the verge of a crucial battle against the Nightmare invading and corrupting your world. A roguelike action game from the creators of Curse of the Dead Gods©, playable solo or in online co-op.

games.name: SULFUR
games.short_description: SULFUR《火湖》是一款新穎的老式動作冒險遊戲：智取敵人、尋找寶藏、改進武器、駕馭力量。繼續深入，找到答案，了結這一切。
games.short_description_en: SULFUR is a modern old-school action-adventure: Outsmart enemies, find treasure, improve weapons, harness powers. Delve deeper, find answers, make it end.

games.name: Fate/EXTRA Record
games.short_description: 以極致畫質與戰略性對戰系統，盡情享受動人肺腑的故事體驗。此為現代的魔術師們，賭上羈絆與祈願的戰火紀錄。『Fate』系列首款正統RPG，於此新生──
games.short_description_en: Fate/EXTRA Record is the chronicle of a war fought by modern magi who stake their existence on the bonds they form and the wishes they hold. This emotional story unfolds with a sleek, reimagined art style and a new strategic battle system. The first true RPG in the Fate series is reborn!

games.name: Yet Another Zombie Survivors
games.display_name: Yet Another Zombie Survivors - 又一個殭屍倖存者
games.name_zh_cn: Yet Another Zombie Survivors - 又一个僵尸幸存者
games.name_zh_cn_traditional: Yet Another Zombie Survivors - 又一個殭屍倖存者
games.short_description: 大群敵人即將到來，但你已經做好了戰鬥準備！召集你的隊伍並決定他們的各種增強，以找到對付成千上萬不死生物最有效的組合。努力生存，然後進化。然後在這個看似簡單但令人上癮的反轉彈雨遊戲中打破所有限制。
games.short_description_en: The Horde is coming, but you're ready to fight it! Assemble your squad, choose their upgrades, and build powerful synergies against thousands of undead. Survive. Then evolve. Then break every limit in this deceptively simple but addictive bullet heaven game.

games.name: Neon Abyss 2
games.short_description: 深入《霓虹深淵2》美麗且危險的賽博神話世界！本作支援最多4人聯機遊玩，並將更多樣的戰鬥風格以及無窮無盡的道具協同效果。享受腎上腺素飆升的瞬間，探索每一場令人難忘的冒險吧！
games.short_description_en: Dive into the cybermyth roguelike chaos of Neon Abyss 2! Now featuring up to 4-player online co-op, more combat styles, and unlimited item synergies, every run delivers a dramatic, action-packed experience you won't forget.

games.name: Monster Hunter Wilds
games.short_description: 狂野兇猛的大自然，襲來。 一個時刻都在動態變化的原野。 這是個關於生活在具有兩面性的世界裡之魔物和人們的故事。 得以進化的狩獵動作，以及追求不間斷的沉浸感之極致的狩獵體驗正在等待著您。
games.short_description_en: The unbridled force of nature runs wild and relentless, with environments transforming drastically from one moment to the next. This is a story of monsters and humans and their struggles to live in harmony in a world of duality.

games.name: Station to Station
games.display_name: 站點連連 Station to Station
games.name_zh_tw: 站點連連 Station to Station
games.name_zh_cn: 站点连连 Station to Station
games.name_zh_tw_traditional: 站點連連 Station to Station
games.name_zh_cn_traditional: 站點連連 Station to Station
games.short_description: Station to Station 是一款極簡主義且放鬆的遊戲，講述的是建造鐵路連接的故事。戴上您的列車長帽子，透過火車的魔力，將像素藝術的世界帶入生活！
games.short_description_en: ‘Station to Station’ is a minimalist & relaxing game about building railway connections. Grab your conductor’s hat and bring the voxel-art world to life through the magic of trains!

games.name: Riders Republic
games.short_description: 躍入遼闊的多人遊樂場！用單車、雙板滑雪板、單板滑雪板或飛鼠裝來橫越開放世界的體育天堂，你可以自己制定或打破一切規則。
games.short_description_en: Jump into a massive multiplayer playground! Bike, ski, snowboard, or wingsuit across an open world sports paradise where the rules are yours to make or break.

games.name: Deep Rock Galactic: Survivor
games.short_description: DEEP ROCK GALACTIC: SURVIVOR 是一款單機類倖存者放置型射擊遊戲。玩家可裝備 Deep Rock Galactic 中的各種武器對抗無窮無盡的致命外星生物，並挖掘地下寶石解鎖強力的升級。這是一款一名矮人隻身對抗整座哈克瑟斯星球的遊戲！
games.short_description_en: DEEP ROCK GALACTIC: SURVIVOR is a single player survivor-like auto-shooter. Take on hordes of lethal aliens, mine riches, and unlock powerful upgrades to survive, as you wield the full arsenal of Deep Rock Galactic. It's one dwarf against all of Planet Hoxxes!

games.name: Spirit Crossing
games.short_description: 由《Cozy Grove》開發團隊打造：在柔和的粉彩雲朵中滑翔，幫助迷失的靈魂，並設計坐落在高山之巔、專屬於你的家園。在溫暖的營火旁與陌生人建立友誼，或與好友一邊悠閒地在天空中釣魚，一邊分享回憶。歡迎來到屬於你的奇異新家。🏠🏔️
games.short_description_en: From the makers of Cozy Grove: Glide through pastel clouds, help lost spirits along the way, and design your own home nestled high on a mountain peak. Befriend strangers around a warm campfire, or share memories while lazily fishing in the sky with a friend. Welcome to your strange new home. 🏠🏔️

games.name: Titanium Court
games.short_description: A critically-acclaimed surreal masterpiece. This is how AP Thomson would describe Titanium Court if not for the curse he bears as punishment for his hubris. Instead he can only use the crudest of terms and so he describes Titanium Court as "a clever ploy to trick gamers into reading my book." Yuck!
games.short_description_en: A critically-acclaimed surreal masterpiece. This is how AP Thomson would describe Titanium Court if not for the curse he bears as punishment for his hubris. Instead he can only use the crudest of terms and so he describes Titanium Court as "a clever ploy to trick gamers into reading my book." Yuck!

games.name: Eriksholm: The Stolen Dream
games.display_name: 埃裏克斯霍姆：被偷走的夢
games.name_zh_cn: 埃里克斯霍姆：被偷走的梦
games.name_zh_cn_traditional: 埃裏克斯霍姆：被偷走的夢
games.short_description: 在這款通過敘事推動的等距視角隱蔽類遊戲中進入生氣蓬勃的城市埃裡克斯霍姆，與漢娜一起踏上冒險之旅。漢娜的弟弟赫爾曼神秘失蹤，由此引發一連串災難性事件，徹底改變了大家的生活和整個城市的命運。
games.short_description_en: Experience an isometric, narrative-driven stealth game and join Hanna’s adventure in the vibrant city of Eriksholm. The mysterious disappearance of her brother, Herman, ignites a chain of catastrophic events that will forever change their lives and the fate of the entire city.

games.name: Dungeons & Degenerate Gamblers
games.short_description: 《再來一張》是一款以撲克牌為基礎的肉鴿卡牌遊戲，你將穿越一家酒館，與各種各樣的人決鬥，不斷構建自己的牌組。但遊戲中不只有撲克牌，還有獨特功能的塔羅牌，節日賀卡，藏在袖子裡的A......從超過200張卡牌中構建自己的牌組，參與各種隨機事件，每一局都有不同的體驗。
games.short_description_en: Battle your way through a seedy tavern filled with gambling addicted townspeople in this Blackjack Roguelike Adventure. From aces and face cards to tarot cards, business cards and more, create your unique deck to beat the house.

games.name: Gennady
games.short_description: 《怒漢阿根》是一款動態 Roguelike 平臺動作遊戲。你將在不斷變化的走廊中對抗異星生物，一路殺出重圍，而死亡只會讓你變得更強。遊戲以 90 年代手繪動畫式的荒誕表現、誇張動作和怪誕幽默，打造出一個瘋狂的超現實世界。
games.short_description_en: Gennady is a dynamic roguelike platformer, where you must fight your way through shifting corridors filled with chthonic creatures, and death only makes you stronger. All wrapped in the legendary absurdity and classic animation inspired by the era of Earthworm Jim.

games.name: Sword of the Sea
games.short_description: 開啟一段史詩般的衝浪之旅，在壯闊的沙浪與波光粼粼的水域間馳騁，只為重現那片已逝的海洋。《Sword of the Sea》出自創作《ABZÛ》、《風之旅人》和《無路之旅》的傑出藝術家之手，是一款充滿氛圍感的衝浪冒險遊戲。其高速懸浮劍的操控靈感汲取自滑板與滑雪板的靈動，讓你體驗前所未有的速度與激情。
games.short_description_en: Surf across magnificent waves of sand and glistening waters on an epic quest to restore a lost ocean. From the visionary artist behind ABZÛ, The Pathless, and Journey, Sword of the Sea is an atmospheric surfing adventure with fast movement inspired by classic skateboarding and snowboarding games.

games.name: Tormented Souls 2
games.short_description: 卡羅琳．沃克回歸得獎經典生存恐怖遊戲續作，探索赫斯莊園隱蔽的破敗遺址，利用臨時武器對戰恐怖生物，扭曲現實世界以從邪教手中救出你的妹妹。
games.short_description_en: Caroline Walker returns in the sequel to the award-winning survival horror classic. Explore the decaying remains of the secluded Villa Hess, use improvised weapons to confront terrifying creatures, and bend the fabric of reality to save your sister from a twisted cult.

games.name: Mouthwashing
games.short_description: 拓帕號的五名船員受困於茫茫宇宙中。永恆日落壟罩，老天卻別過目光。
games.short_description_en: The five crew members of the Tulpar are stranded in the empty reaches of space, shrouded in perpetual sunset. God is not watching.

games.name: SpongeBob SquarePants: Titans of the Tide
games.name_en: SpongeBob SquarePants: Titans of the Tide
games.short_description: 來一場驚心動魄的破膽旅程吧！飛行荷蘭人和海神王爆發了激烈衝突，導致鬼魂在全比奇堡到處作亂。玩家可以隨時切換使用海綿寶寶或派大星、搭配使用兩人的獨特技能，在鬼魂之亂中拯救比奇堡！
games.short_description_en: Prepare to be scared! A clash between the Flying Dutchman and King Neptune has unleashed ghostly mayhem all over Bikini Bottom. Switch seamlessly between SpongeBob and Patrick, combine their unique skills and save Bikini Bottom from total ghostification!

console_titles: SpongeBob SquarePants: Titans of the Tide

games.name: FATAL FURY: City of the Wolves
games.name_en: FATAL FURY: City of the Wolves
games.short_description: 時隔26年，《餓狼傳說》再次開始！新搭載了刺激感性的獨自「美術風格」、加速了戰鬥興奮度的「REV系統」。此外，以從初學者到熟練者都能充分享受的2種操作方式為首，也準備了各種新功能和新元素。以充滿慾望的南鎮為舞臺，新的「傳說」即將開始。
games.short_description_en: 26 years on, a brand-new entry in the Fatal Fury series is set to arrive on the scene! FATAL FURY: City of the Wolves features a unique art style that stimulates the senses and an innovative REV System that supercharges the excitement. Here, at long last, a new legend is about to unfold…

console_titles: Fatal Fury: City of the Wolves

games.name: GRIME II
games.short_description: 在超現實動作冒險類銀河戰士惡魔城遊戲《GRIME II》中扮演形體盜賊，伸出雙手化成的觸手吸收敵人，召喚以敵人形體現身的畫身，探索這個痴迷藝術的奇異世界。
games.short_description_en: Become the stealer of forms in GRIME II, a surreal action-adventure metroidvania. Launch tendrils made of hands to absorb foes and summon molds in their shape, as you explore a bizarre lived-in-world obsessed with art.

games.name: KINGDOM HEARTS III + Re Mind (DLC)
games.short_description: 此為系列最新作品，是從第一部作品開始的「黑暗探求者篇」的完結篇。除了以迪士尼世界的舞臺展開的故事，更加入皮克斯作品等全新世界，發展出更加龐大的世界觀。另外，也收錄描寫發生在本作劇情高潮中的另一篇章「Re Mind」。
games.short_description_en: KINGDOM HEARTS III + Re Mind (DLC) brings one chapter of the series to a close. Travel to exciting new Disney and Pixar worlds, and prepare for the final showdown.

games.name: Metaphor: ReFantazio
games.short_description: 《暗喻幻想：ReFantazio》是一款奇幻RPG，描述在國王遇刺後，少年被捲入突然展開的選舉中，成為新國王候選人，其命運就此轉動。在環遊世界的每一天之中，玩家可自由選擇如何度過，並可使用各種職階與隊伍來對抗強敵們。現在，就讓我們開始「只有在幻想中才能實現的現實之旅」吧。
games.short_description_en: After his assassination, the will of the late king decrees the next monarch to be elected by the people. Forge bonds and win over a kingdom divided in this award-winning fantasy RPG with turn-based and action combat, party customization with powerful Archetypes, and hours of exploration.

games.name: Waltz and Jam
games.short_description: 「磕磕絆絆圓舞曲」是一款單人動作冒險平臺遊戲，以獨特風格重新詮釋七大罪，打造死後世界作為背景，描繪純真靈魂「華爾茲」與可愛小狗「傑姆」展開的冒險。
games.short_description_en: Waltz and Jam is a single-player action-adventure platformer following the adventures of Waltz, a pure soul, and Jam, his lovable dog companion. It is set in an afterlife born from a unique reimagination of the Seven Deadly Sins.

games.name: The Crew Motorfest
games.short_description: 《飆酷車神：動力慶典》是一款以夏威夷歐胡島為背景的開放世界線上競速遊戲。在激烈賽事中體驗汽車文化的精華、參與主題活動，同時收集數百款經典車輛。 免費暢玩遊戲 5 小時！
games.short_description_en: Welcome to Motorfest, the ultimate open-world driving experience. Explore the Hawaiian islands of O'ahu and Maui. Celebrate the best of car culture through 20+ themed campaigns (street racing, offroad, drift...) and collect hundreds of iconic vehicles. Enjoy the game free for 5 hours!

games.name: Aeterna Lucis
games.short_description: 《Aeterna Lucis》是我們最純正的銀河惡魔城，也是《Aeterna Noctis》的續作。化身光之女王，探索手繪的廣袤互聯世界，喚醒全新力量，迎戰史詩級 Boss，阻止至高神混沌。
games.short_description_en: Aeterna Lucis is our purest metroidvania yet and the sequel to Aeterna Noctis. Become the Queen of Light, explore a vast, hand-drawn interconnected world, awaken new powers and face epic bosses to stop the Supreme God Chaos.

games.name: Petal Runner
games.short_description: 騎上你的小摩托，和卡利、琦拉一起馳騁在陽光普照的藍寶石谷，成為真正的花娜精靈配送員吧！送貨、交友、玩小遊戲——在這款陽光朋克像素風開放世界 RPG 裡，發現生活得失中的美好珍貴。
games.short_description_en: Hop on your bike and join Cali and Kira as they ride across the sun-soaked city of Sapphire Valley and become Petal Runners! Make deliveries, meet new friends, play minigames, and discover a solarpunk, pixel art-powered open-world RPG about life, loss, and what we carry with us.

games.name: The Relic: First Guardian
games.short_description: 一款以韓國神話為根基、戰鬥激烈殘酷的黑暗動作 RPG。
games.short_description_en: A dark action RPG rooted in Korean mythology, with brutal, fast combat.

games.name: Among Us Story: On Guard
games.short_description: 在這場危機四伏的太空冒險中，身為一枚小船員的你要如何自保呢？！化身「守衛」的你，負責的是整艘飛船的安保業務。直到有一天，一樁突如其來的殺人案卻劃破了這樣的寧靜！在偽裝者把魔掌伸向船上其他人和你之前，快想辦法證明自己是清白的。
games.short_description_en: Live life as a Crewmate in this dangerous narrative adventure through space. As Guard, you're in charge of shipwide security and everything is fine. Until there's a MURDER?! Prove your innocence before the Impostor gets to the rest of the crew... and you.

games.name: ZERO PARADES: Director's Cut
games.short_description: 在《極樂迪斯可 - 最終剪輯版》製作團隊的全新間諜角色扮演遊戲《ZERO PARADES: For Dead Spies》中，你將扮演一位傑出但心力交瘁的特務，進行最後一場絕望的任務。集合你破碎的情報網路，揭開謊言之網，並對全世界證明自己的能力，或是再次將一切毀滅。
games.short_description_en: From the creators of Disco Elysium comes ZERO PARADES - the acclaimed espionage RPG, now expanded with the DIRECTOR'S CUT. You're a brilliant but tormented operant on one final desperate assignment. Prove yourself on the world stage - or blow it all up again.

games.name: Demon Slayer -Kimetsu no Yaiba- The Hinokami Chronicles 2
games.display_name: 鬼滅之刃 火之神血風譚2
games.name_en: Demon Slayer -Kimetsu no Yaiba- The Hinokami Chronicles 2
games.name_zh_tw: 鬼滅之刃 火之神血風譚2
games.name_zh_cn: 鬼灭之刃 火之神血风谭2
games.name_zh_tw_traditional: 鬼滅之刃 火之神血風譚2
games.name_zh_cn_traditional: 鬼滅之刃 火之神血風譚2
games.short_description: 以「羈絆」之刃，斬殺惡鬼！ 灶門炭治郎的戰鬥再次於家用遊戲上演————
games.short_description_en: Destroy demons with the power of forged bonds! Tanjiro Kamado's battle will once again unfold…

console_titles: Demon Slayer: Kimetsu no Yaiba - The Hinokami Chronicles 2

games.name: Trine 6: Together in Time
games.short_description: 《Trine 6: Together in Time》是一款支援1至4人的合作解謎平臺遊戲。運用智慧、節奏與合作，破解謎題、對抗狡猾生物，穿越險峻道路，展開全新奇幻冒險。
games.short_description_en: Trine 6: Together in Time is a co-op puzzle platformer for 1–4 players. Wit, timing, and teamwork collide as you solve perplexing puzzles, engage cunning creatures, and traverse perilous paths in the next adventure through Trine’s iconic fairytale world.

games.name: Ratatan
games.short_description: 《啦嗒噹》是一款融合了節奏跟橫軸動作，可以最多四人一起合作的Roguelike節奏動作遊戲。有100隻以上的角色一起展開激烈的大亂鬥。伴隨著充滿動態節奏感的BGM一起打敗敵人吧！
games.short_description_en: Ratatan is a rhythm roguelike action game that combines rhythm games and side-scrolling action, with online co-op gameplay supporting up to 4 players. An intense battle unfolds with over 100 characters fighting in a massive melee. Let's defeat the enemies together!

games.name: LEGO® Harry Potter™ Collection
games.short_description: 《LEGO® Harry Potter™: Collection》將《LEGO® Harry Potter™：1-4 年級》和《LEGO® Harry Potter™：5-7 年級》整合到一個遊戲中，現已重製並增強圖形品質。
games.short_description_en: The LEGO® Harry Potter™: Collection brings LEGO® Harry Potter™: Years 1-4 and LEGO® Harry Potter™: Years 5-7 together in one game, now remastered with enhanced graphics.

games.name: Vice: Magic City Mayhem
games.short_description: 復古動作冒險遊戲：戰鬥、收集裝備並強化角色，在夜店、海灘與被迅猛龍佔據的遊艇之間展開冒險。
games.short_description_en: Vice: Magic City Mayhem is a retro action-adventure game where you fight, collect new items, and upgrade your character as you make your way through bustling nightclubs, scenic beaches, and raptor-infested yachts.

games.name: Herdling
games.short_description: 帶領一群神秘的生物，踏上激勵人心又美麗的旅程，爬上群山…以及更遙遠的彼方。
games.short_description_en: Guide a herd of mysterious creatures on a stirring and beautiful journey into the mountains… and beyond.

games.name: DevilConnection
games.short_description: 在這款惡魔調教冒險遊戲中，盡情做一些背德的事吧～ 為了幫助壞小鬼惡魔「德比倫」恢復真正的姿態，召喚個性豐富的萌萌獸人們狠狠榨取魔力！
games.short_description_en: Punish the little bastard demon and being punished too! Cemo-Summoning Adventure Game

games.name: Bluey's Happy Snaps
games.short_description: 遊戲時間到囉！和布麗與賓果一起在這款以拍照為主題的遊戲中盡情探索，捕捉你最喜愛的精彩瞬間。睜大眼睛尋找熟悉的卡通場景並創作出專屬於你的剪貼簿，將遊戲裡的美好回憶變成現實生活中的歡樂時光。
games.short_description_en: Time to play! Explore, have fun and capture your favorite moments with Bluey and Bingo in this photo-powered game. Look out for familiar spots from the show, create your own scrapbook and turn in-game memories into playful moments for real life.

games.name: Cat Me If You Can
games.short_description: 《Cat Me If You Can》是一款溫馨又療癒的遊戲。步入精美的黑白手繪世界，體驗不同文化的風景，尋找隱藏起來的貓咪，用鏡頭捕捉牠們，繼而讓貓咪恢復色彩。
games.short_description_en: Cat Me If You Can is a charming and cozy game where you explore beautifully handcrafted black-and-white worlds, searching for hidden cats to photograph and bring their colours back into the world.

games.name: Deck of Haunts
games.short_description: 《幽室鬼牌》（Deck of Haunts）邀請你成為一棟惡意滿滿的鬼屋。引誘敵人走進你的詛咒大廳、操控他們的恐懼、汲取精魂，壯大你的力量。使用戰術打造你的宅邸，擴張你的暗黑影響力，將你的房屋變成一幢懾人卻逃不出的夢魘。
games.short_description_en: Deck of Haunts invites you to become a malevolent Haunted House. Lure humans into your cursed halls, manipulate their fears, and drain their essence to grow your power. Use strategy to build your mansion and expand your dark influence, turning your home into a terrifying, inescapable nightmare.

games.name: Don Bradman Cricket Jr
games.short_description: FAST. FUN. CRICKET! Step onto the pitch and feel the thrill of every shot. Don Bradman Cricket Jr is fast, accessible cricket that's easy to learn and rewarding to master. Smash boundaries, outplay opponents and make every run count.
games.short_description_en: FAST. FUN. CRICKET! Step onto the pitch and feel the thrill of every shot. Don Bradman Cricket Jr is fast, accessible cricket that's easy to learn and rewarding to master. Smash boundaries, outplay opponents and make every run count.

games.name: Look Outside
games.short_description: 《Look Outside》是生存恐怖角色扮演遊戲，以一棟公寓建築為背景。某起神秘事件發生後，任何望向窗外的人都變成了怪誕的怪物，全世界徹底陷入混亂。在公寓裡四處尋找食物、物資、武器，並且應對多名古怪角色。
games.short_description_en: Look Outside is a survival horror RPG set in a single apartment building. A mysterious event turns anyone who looks out the window into grotesque monsters, leaving the world in absolute chaos. Scavenge the building to seek food, supplies, and weapons while encountering strange characters.

games.name: Professor Layton and the New World of Steam
games.display_name: 雷頓教授與蒸氣新世界
games.name_en: Professor Layton and the New World of Steam
games.name_zh_tw: 雷頓教授與蒸氣新世界

games.name_zh_tw_traditional: 雷頓教授與蒸氣新世界
games.name_zh_cn_traditional: 雷頓教授與蒸汽新世界
games.short_description: 累積銷量突破2000萬套的奇幻解謎冒險遊戲「雷頓」系列，迎來全新篇章！ 隨著蒸氣技術日新月異，發明小鎮「真契拜森」也充滿了創新與活力。 一樁發生在這座小鎮的離奇事件，讓雷頓教授與路克踏上了全新的冒險旅程。
games.short_description_en: A new adventure in Professor Layton, the puzzle-filled fantasy adventure series that has sold over 20 million copies worldwide. Professor Layton and Luke find themselves drawn into a mysterious case in Steam Bison, a remarkable town of invention powered by steam engine technology.

console_titles: Professor Layton and the New World of Steam

games.display_name: 棒球殺手 LEAGUE-MAN Bases Loaded
games.name_zh_tw: 棒球殺手 LEAGUE-MAN Bases Loaded
games.name_zh_cn: 忍者棒球 LEAGUE-MAN Bases Loaded

games.name_zh_cn_traditional: 忍者棒球 LEAGUE-MAN Bases Loaded
games.short_description: 投球、揮棒、大亂鬥！結合棒球與格鬥的90年代傳奇街機橫向捲軸動作遊戲HD重製復刻！ 追加新角色、新模式、新關卡與新BGM，更支援最多4人多人遊玩！
games.short_description_en: Throw, hit, and brawl! The legendary 90s arcade beat 'em up combining baseball and martial arts returns in HD! Packed with new characters, modes, stages, and music, plus up to 4-player co-op!

games.name: The Cat in the Hat: Rainy Day Mayhem
games.name_en: The Cat in the Hat: Rainy Day Mayhem
games.name_zh_cn: 戴帽子的猫：雨天大乱斗
games.name_zh_cn_traditional: 戴帽子的貓：雨天大亂鬥
games.short_description: 戴帽子的貓說過：找樂趣很有意思。歡迎跟他和你喜愛的書中角色玩 18 種精彩小遊戲，在屋內追著他到處跑。無論是單人還是與好友一起玩，你的屋子將會充滿歡笑、驚嘆和熱鬧。
games.short_description_en: The Cat in the Hat once said, “It’s fun to have fun.” Play with him and your favorite characters in 18 exciting minigames or chase him around the house. Whether you play solo or with friends, your house is about to be full of giggles, groans, and glorious mayhem.

console_titles: The Cat in the Hat: Rainy Day Mayhem

games.name: Tales of Eternia Remastered
games.short_description: 永遠和羈絆的RPG，《永恆傳奇》以Remastered 復出！世界毀滅的危機逼近，伊菲利亞與塞雷斯迪亞，賭上兩世界命運的壯闊旅行，現在啟程。
games.short_description_en: Tales of Eternia returns as a remastered edition! As the threat of world destruction looms, an epic journey begins to determine the fate of two worlds: Inferia and Celestia.

games.name: Stellar Blade™
games.short_description: 在末日後動作冒險遊戲《劍星》中，拯救瀕臨滅絕的人類。體驗激烈戰鬥與峰迴路轉的劇情，揭開地球淪亡的秘密。
games.short_description_en: Save humanity from extinction in post-apocalyptic action-adventure Stellar Blade™. Experience blistering combat and a twisting storyline as you unravel the mysteries of Earth’s downfall.

games.name: Hillthorn
games.short_description: 一樁發生在僻靜社區的失蹤案。一座埋藏著重重秘密的山。一位和時間賽跑的偵探。這就是《Hillthorn》，一款暗黑風格的調查推理遊戲。全程無對白，你只能依靠手中的卡牌、腦中的邏輯與直覺探尋真相。
games.short_description_en: A disappearance in a secluded community. A mountain hiding its secrets. A detective running out of time. Welcome to Hillthorn, a dark investigation game that invites you to uncover the mystery without a single word spoken, using your skills of logic and intuition through cards.

games.name: Everything is Crab: The Animal Evolution Roguelite
games.display_name: 萬物皆可蟹：動物演化Roguelite遊戲 | Everything is Crab
games.name_en: Everything is Crab: The Animal Evolution Roguelite
games.name_zh_tw: 萬物皆可蟹：動物演化Roguelite遊戲 | Everything is Crab
games.name_zh_cn: 万物皆可蟹：动物进化 Roguelite | Everything is Crab
games.name_zh_tw_traditional: 萬物皆可蟹：動物演化Roguelite遊戲 | Everything is Crab
games.name_zh_cn_traditional: 萬物皆可蟹：動物進化 Roguelite | Everything is Crab
games.short_description: 動物演化Roguelite遊戲 狩獵、逃亡、覓食，並在生生不息的生態圈中發展成長。有超過160種進化及專精選項，讓你在每回閤中挑選、創造各種獨特的組合。為了生存，適應環境來打破蟹化理論……又或者是在嘗試的過程中，被達爾文宣告淘汰！
games.short_description_en: The Animal Evolution Roguelite. Hunt, Flee, Scavenge and Thrive in a living ecosystem. Choose from 160+ Evolutions and Specialisations for unique creature combinations in every run. Adapt to survive the natural curve in order to beat carcinisation... or get Darwin'd trying!

games.name: PEAK
games.short_description: 《PEAK》是一款合作登山遊戲，就連最微小的錯誤都能招致你的死亡。無論你是獨自一人，或是與其他童軍團成員一同迷失於大自然中，你從這座神秘小島獲救的唯一希望，就是攀上小島中心的山峰。你有攻頂《PEAK》的能耐嗎？
games.short_description_en: PEAK is a co-op climbing game where the slightest mistake can spell your doom. Either solo or as a group of lost nature scouts, your only hope of rescue from a mysterious island is to scale the mountain at its center. Do you have what it takes to reach the PEAK?

games.name: Harvest Moon®: Echoes of Teradea
games.short_description: 踏上穿越奇幻世界泰拉迪亞的難忘旅程，體驗寧靜農場生活與刺激冒險的完美結合！神秘迷霧從迷霧森林蔓延而出，野獸在夜幕下徘徊，奇異災害威脅著大地上的村莊。
games.short_description_en: Embark on an unforgettable journey through the enchanting world of Teradea, where peaceful farm life meets thrilling adventure! A mysterious mist creeps from the Forest of Echoes, wild beasts roam under the cover of night, and strange disasters threaten villages across the land.

games.name: 007 First Light
games.short_description: 贏得你的代號。007 初露鋒芒 是由 IO Interactive 推出的刺激間諜動作冒險遊戲。扮演年輕又足智多謀，有時卻有些魯莽的 MI6 訓練計畫新人詹姆士・龐德，探索這位全球最知名間諜的起源故事。
games.short_description_en: Earn the Number. 007 First Light is a thrilling espionage action-adventure game from IO Interactive. Follow James Bond as a young, resourceful and sometimes reckless recruit in MI6's training programme, and discover an origin story of the world’s most famous spy.

games.name: Eternal Anima
games.short_description: 獻給所有JRPG愛好者，以「傳承」與「進化」為概念的完全新作。穿梭於過去與現代，在宏大的故事中逐步揭開失落的歷史真相。簡單易懂的回合制指令戰鬥，結合能預知行動結果的「未來預測」系統，打造出兼具深度與樂趣的獨特戰略性玩法。
games.short_description_en: Embark on an adventure across eras in this love letter to JRPGs. Journey between the past and present to uncover the truth behind a lost history. Control your fate in turn-based combat by using Future Sight to foresee enemy actions and strategically rewrite the future.

games.name: RACCOIN: Coin Pusher Roguelike
games.short_description: 《浣熊推幣機》是一款讓人多巴胺狂飆、欲罷不能的萌系推幣機遊戲！將經典街機推幣機的混亂樂趣，與肉鴿卡組構建元素巧妙融合。組合各種特殊硬幣與強力道具，觸發爽度爆表的加乘效果。準備好被金幣淹沒，踏上這場停不下來的多巴胺派對吧～！
games.short_description_en: A coin-pushing dopamine machine. RACCOIN is a roguelike deckbuilder where you combine special coins with powerful items to trigger wildly satisfying combos. Stack shiny towers, spin the lucky wheel, and shake the machine until all the coins drop.

games.name: The Wolf Among Us Remastered
games.short_description: A dark detective thriller where folklore is real, violence is chilling, and every choice has consequences.
games.short_description_en: A dark detective thriller where folklore is real, violence is chilling, and every choice has consequences.

games.name: CRYMELIGHT
games.short_description: 《慟哭幽光／CRYMELIGHT》是一款Rogue類型的動作遊戲，故事背景為死後的世界，犯下罪孽的少女們要面對自己的罪過並為了自由而戰。
games.short_description_en: CRYMELIGHT is a roguelike action game set in the world of the afterlife, where girls confront their sins as they fight to gain their freedom.

games.name: ONE PIECE: Grand Gourmet
games.short_description: 跟草帽一行人一起經營芭拉蒂2號店！ 從小船上揭幕的是專屬於您的海上餐廳。 收集食材開發新菜單、用室內裝飾隨心所欲裝潢店內…… 隨著提升餐廳的水準，這間店會成長得越來越充滿朝氣與活力，就連「那個角色」也有機會變成這裡的常客。 每當夥伴或常客增加，您的餐廳便會離大海上人人讚不絕口的店更邁進一步！ 「ONE PIECE」角色們大排長龍的海上餐廳，今日開業！
games.short_description_en: Hop aboard a delectable management sim in the world of ONE PIECE! Work alongside the Straw Hat Crew to build the greatest floating restaurant of the seas. Collect ingredients, dream up dishes, and decorate to have familiar faces lining up for more!

games.name: Village in the Shade
games.short_description: 在這款全新的農場模擬遊戲中，體驗日本村落寧靜的鄉村生活吧！但請務必遵守規則——否則後果自負！
games.short_description_en: Enjoy quiet, countryside living in a Japanese village in this brand new farming sim! Just make sure you follow the rules—or else!

games.name: Queen's Blade Re:Build
games.short_description: 有別於傳統回合制卡牌遊戲，《Queen's Blade Re:Build》將緊湊刺激的即時卡牌戰鬥和深度 Roguelite 體驗巧妙融合。蒐集強力卡牌和改變戰局的珍稀道具，活用系列經典的「破甲」機制，瓦解對手防禦後施展致命終結一擊！有別於傳統回合制卡牌遊戲，《Re:Build》將緊湊刺激的即時卡牌戰鬥和深度 Roguelite 體驗巧妙融合。蒐集強力卡牌和改變戰局的珍稀道具，活用系列經典的「破甲」機制，瓦解對手防禦後施展致命終結一擊！
games.short_description_en: A roguelite deckbuilder featuring strong, beautiful female warriors. We fused real time card games and roguelite together to make the exciting single player deckbuilder. Discover new cards and item, Craft a strong deck. Break your rival of all their armor and defeat them with a finishing move!

games.name: STEINS;GATE RE:BOOT
games.short_description: 《STEINS;GATE》以現代標準全面重啟！角色與畫面煥然一新，並追加全新劇情！ 角色設計、圖像、UI全部更新，將更清晰深入地描繪熟悉的秋葉原。
games.short_description_en: STEINS;GATE returns! Rebooted for the modern era! Featuring fully updated visuals, UI, and an all-new story that breathes new life into the streets of Akihabara.

games.name: Sakunaverse
games.short_description: “你要打造什麼樣的未來？” 目標是頂級VTuber！ 來當昨奈的製作人，把她培養成只屬於你的最棒VTuber－－「大天使昨喵」吧！ 和昨奈並肩同行，支持她VTuber活動的每一天，就此拉開序幕。 活動的形式不只一種，追求的夢想不只一個。 連同兩人相伴的日常生活，也會因你的每一次抉擇而改變。 無限的可能性，盡在你的培養之中。 最終的故事，由你來書寫！
games.short_description_en: "What kind of future will you produce?" Aim to create the ultimate VTuber! Guide Sakuna on her journey to becoming the one and only "Archangel Sakunyan." Support her daily streams, make choices together, and shape her story. Countless possibilities await... her greatest future is all up to you!

games.name: Disney•Pixar Toy Story 3 Complete Edition
games.short_description: 重新打開玩具箱，化身胡迪、巴斯光年與翠絲，在根據 2010 年熱門動畫電影《玩具總動員 3》改編的 3D 冒險遊戲《Toy Story 3 Complete Edition》中展開冒險。可選擇故事模式體驗電影中的經典時刻，或是選擇玩具箱模式跳進《胡迪牛仔秀》的西部沙盒世界。
games.short_description_en: Reopen the toy chest and saddle up as Woody, Buzz Lightyear, and Jessie in Toy Story 3 Complete Edition, a 3D adventure based on the hit 2010 animated film, Toy Story 3. Play through authentic movie moments in Story Mode, or drop into the wild west sandbox of Woody’s Roundup in Toy Box Mode.

games.name: Super Battle Golf
games.short_description: 一款支援 1 至 8 人同時在線競技的高爾夫遊戲。大家同時揮桿、射擊，偶爾還能「搞點小花招」，用自己的方式盡快把球送進洞。在輕鬆又熱鬧的混戰中，先完成的玩家就是贏家。
games.short_description_en: An online 1-8 player golf game where everyone plays at the same time. Swing, shoot, sabotage, and finish first by any means necessary in a free-for-all rush to the hole.

games.name: Hasbro Games™ Junior Collection
games.short_description: 3 款經典青少年棋盤遊戲，盡在一組家庭遊戲之夜的冒險中！
games.short_description_en: 3 classic junior board games in one family game night adventure!

games.name: Terranigma
games.short_description: Thematic boldness. Stunning character design. Excellent music. Smooth gameplay. Terranigma had it all... except a modern re-release. Now, the beloved action JRPG classic is back for the first time since 1995!
games.short_description_en: Thematic boldness. Stunning character design. Excellent music. Smooth gameplay. Terranigma had it all... except a modern re-release. Now, the beloved action JRPG classic is back for the first time since 1995!

games.name: Croc 2 Kingdom of the Gobbos
games.short_description: Croc's back, and this time he's searching for his long-lost parents. Revived by the Dantinis, arch enemy Baron Dante vows revenge. Explore four mainland villages, rescue Gobbos, and battle new Guardians. Race cars and speedboats, ride minecarts, and take to the skies in the remastered 1999 classic.

Explore four mainland villages, rescue Gobbos, and battle new Guardians. Race cars and speedboats, ride minecarts, and take to the skies in the remastered 1999 classic.

games.short_description: 《復活邪神3》完全重製！ 透過3D畫面、進化的遊戲系統、重新編曲的BGM與語音，讓那段冒險再次甦醒。 本作是一款指令式RPG，玩家可從八位主角中選擇一位，挑戰圍繞「宿命之子」的命運。
games.short_description_en: Experience a full remake of Romancing SaGa 3, featuring fully realized 3D graphics, refined gameplay systems, new musical arrangements, voice acting, and more. Choose from eight different protagonists and embark on a turn-based RPG adventure as you uncover the fate of the Child of Destiny.

games.name: SONIC PICO PARK
games.short_description: 多人合作動作解謎遊戲《PICO PARK》系列推出最新作──與SEGA《索尼克》的聯名合作！ 遊戲內充滿大量兼具《索尼克》特色與《PICO PARK》風格的合作玩法！支援單機／線上模式，可供二至八位玩家遊玩喔！
games.short_description_en: The co-op action puzzle game series PICO PARK is back... and this time, we're teaming up with SEGA's legendary Sonic the Hedgehog! This collaboration is packed with co-op gameplay that combines the flair of Sonic with the puzzle teamwork fun of PICO PARK! Play locally or online with 2 to 8 players!

games.name: Arizona Sunshine®
games.short_description: Sharpen your machete and grab your friends. Arizona Sunshine® brings its award-winning zombie apocalypse to explosive third-person action, featuring online and split-screen co-op, brutal combat, dark humor, and Buddy, your loyal zombie-chomping canine companion.
games.short_description_en: Sharpen your machete and grab your friends. Arizona Sunshine® brings its award-winning zombie apocalypse to explosive third-person action, featuring online and split-screen co-op, brutal combat, dark humor, and Buddy, your loyal zombie-chomping canine companion.

games.short_description: 踏上獨角獸島，以一年級新生之姿入學獨角獸學院，展開這場美麗的開放世界冒險。
games.short_description_en: You are invited to join Unicorn Academy! Create a magical connection with your own unicorn and forge friendship bonds with Sophia, Ava, Layla and the other heroes from the series. Wield unicorn magic and discover every corner of Unicorn Island.

games.name: STAGE TOUR
games.short_description: Build your band, hit the stage, and go on tour in Stage Tour, the next evolution of music rhythm games. Rock over 90 officially licensed tracks, unlock over 180 authentic Gibson®, Epiphone® and Kramer® guitars, and experience five game modes, including the all-new roguelite Tour Mode.

Rock over 90 officially licensed tracks, unlock over 180 authentic Gibson®, Epiphone® and Kramer® guitars, and experience five game modes, including the all-new roguelite Tour Mode.

games.name: Moomin: Midsummer Madness
games.short_description: 與姆明一家展開一場溫馨的冒險。本作靈感來自朵貝・楊笙的《姆米一家的瘋狂夏日》。這一次，姆明、小美與朋友們需要你的幫助，在大洪水中逃離危機，並找出回到姆明谷的路。
games.short_description_en: Midsummer is right around the corner in Moominvalley, when a sudden flood sets the Moomins adrift! Join Tove Jansson’s beloved Moominfamily and friends on an adventure of mirth and mischief aboard a mysterious floating theatre.

games.short_description: 戰火蔽日，鳳舞長空。由「Team NINJA」傾情打造的暗黑三國動作RPG。施展迅疾凌厲的中華武術動作，過關斬將、斬妖除魔，縱橫三國沙場！！
games.short_description_en: Born from war's flames, a Phoenix ascends. A dark fantasy Three Kingdoms action RPG from Team NINJA. Wield acrobatic Chinese martial arts and conquer the vast battlefields of the Three Kingdoms, where mighty generals and demons stand in your way.

games.display_name: 卡莉亞的鍊金工房 ～夜之王國與追憶之道標～

games.short_description: 鍊金術RPG《卡莉亞的鍊金工房》講述的是失去記憶的主角直面自己過去的追憶之旅。本作包含了風格切換、雙重攻擊、回想配方等充滿策略性的戰鬥系統，以及調合與活用調合道具的探索玩法。此外。還加入了可藉由食用素材以解鎖能力的全新功能──「進食」。
games.short_description_en: Atelier Karia tells the story of an adventurer with no memories as she faces her past. New features add to the depth of battles and alchemy. Synthesized items take on new roles during exploration, and ingredients can be eaten to gain effects.

console_titles: Atelier Karia: The Night Kingdom & the Guide of Memories
